name: resource_group_kms_key
description: Registers an existing, customer-managed KMS key against a duploai_resource_group. Downstream resources (e.g. duploai_ecr, duploai_aws_efs, duploai_elasticache, duploai_node_group) can then reference the key via their own kms_key_id attribute; the backend resolves it against this registry. Registering a key does not grant the resource group's IAM role any permissions on it — the key's own key policy must already trust the account/role.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns the parent resource group.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the duploai_resource_group to register this key against.

attributes.name: key_name
attributes.description: Friendly label for this key registration.

attributes.name: key_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the existing customer-managed KMS key, e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. Required, and must be unique within the resource group. An alias ARN is not accepted — the registry matches on the key's own id and ARN. The key's own policy must already grant access to this resource group's account and role; registering it here does not modify that policy.
attributes.patternDescription: must be a KMS key ARN of the form arn:aws:kms:<region>:<12-digit-account>:key/<key-id>, e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. The aws-us-gov partition is accepted; an alias ARN (:alias/...) is not, because the registry matches on the key's own id and ARN

attributes.name: key_id
attributes.description: Raw AWS KMS key ID, e.g. 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab, or a multi-region key id such as mrk-1234abcd12ab34cd56ef1234567890ab. Required by the API even though it also appears inside key_arn, and must be unique within the resource group. Pass the bare id — an ARN here is rejected. Consuming resources may hand either this or key_arn to their own kms_key_id.
attributes.patternDescription: must be a KMS key id: a 36-character UUID such as 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab, or a multi-region key id such as mrk-1234abcd12ab34cd56ef1234567890ab. Pass the bare id here — the full ARN goes in key_arn

attributes.name: key_entry_id
attributes.description: This registration's own backend record ID (distinct from key_id, which is the AWS KMS key's ID).
